record.edic_text:
4117 plegma {pleg'-mah}

from 4120;; n n

AV - broidered hair 1; 1

1) what is woven, plaited, or twisted together
2) a web, plait, braid
   2a) of a net
   2b) of a basket, in which the infant Moses was laid
   2c) of braided hair
